programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Bring Your Daughter to House Hunting Day
programs.desc: A single mother wants to give her 10-year-old daughter the big, beautiful home she never had in the Atlanta suburbs. But with her daughter cheering her on and her mom pumping the brakes, every house they see becomes a three-generation debate.

programs.title: Rock the Block
programs.desc: Teams kick off Week Six by heading outside to renovate their backyards; with a spin of the roulette wheel, each wins a swimming pool to create their own Vegas oasis; former NFL great Danny Amendola arrives to determine who made the right moves.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: After a failed first attempt with another builder, a couple has been waiting two years for their dream home; Brian and Mika arrive to reunite these homeowners with his beloved drum set, and finally get a home that makes their hearts skip a beat.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: Brian and Mika help a hairstylist renovate her mom's home, all while mom is overseas in Germany! She has a tough job trying to execute her mom's vision without her direction, and on top of it, she needs to live in the home during the entire renovation!

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: Thirty years ago, a woman made a vision board of her dream farmhouse, and now she and her newlywed husband aim to make that dream a realit; Brian and Mika look to create a unique floor plan with two main suites and the biggest closet they've ever built.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple bought a fixer-upper with hopes of making it their forever home, but once the walls came down, hidden issues send costs soaring. With the budget busted and surprises around every corner, Brian and Mika step in to save their dream renovation.
